_comment: Opportunities held out of GrantRecs reverse-matching (skip-persist: not written to the GRANT# table, so SPS never indexes or matches them). Seeded 2026-06-22 from the curated awards whose primary topic is the research_infrastructure_workforce catch-all and score >= 0.3 (they clear the match gate but are non-topical service/career/award prizes -> surface the wrong people). Reversible: delete an entry and re-ingest to bring it back. Source-agnostic by opportunity_id; add grants_gov ids here too if needed. Never edits the underlying curated CSV.
